يبتذلوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَذِلُوا (yabtaḏilū) /jab.ta.ði.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# يُبْتَذَلُوا (yubtaḏalū) /jub.ta.ða.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
